title: Walkies, But Make It Pink
description: A pink dog walk kit: a green flower harness, collar and leash set, a cherry blossom poop bag dispenser, a pink crossbody treat pouch, a ball water bottle and pink bow bandanas.
intro: Golden hour, a gravel path and a golden retriever in a flower harness. That is the whole personality. A green flower harness set, a pink bow bandana, a treat bag that crosses the body, a ball water bottle and a cherry blossom poop bag dispenser clipped to the leash. Five finds, one Amazon list.

sections.heading: The harness set sets the tone
paragraphs: The VETRESKA Flora set brings a harness, collar and leash in green with pink flowers. It is the one piece that is not pink, and it is the reason the pink around it works.

sections.heading: The bag you clip on and the pouch you wear
paragraphs: The VETRESKA dispenser comes with 105 cherry blossom bags and clips to the leash. The COOWONE pink treat pouch crosses the body so your hands stay free.

sections.heading: Water and bandanas
paragraphs: A portable stainless steel dog water bottle in a pink ball shape rides in a bag or a cup holder. Two pink bow bandanas from CozyHaus finish the outfit.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The five finds are the harness, collar and leash set, the poop bag dispenser, the treat pouch, the water bottle and the bandanas. The path, porch, bench, dog and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
